senses.gloss: Kukkura, a muni. § 264 (Sabhākriyāp.): II, 4, 113 (waited upon Yudhishṭhira).

Kukkura, pl. (ºāḥ), a people. § 295 (Dyūtap.): II, 52, 1872 (brought tribute to Yudhishṭhira).--§ 574 (Jambūkh.): VI, 9, 368 (ºāṅgāramārishāḥ, in the south).--§ 578 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 51, 2097 (protected Bhīshma). Cf. Kukura, pl.

Kukura, pl. (ºāḥ), a people (a tribe of the Yādavas). § 275 (Rājasūyārambhap.): II, 19, 767 (ºāndhakaiḥ).--§ 452 (Mārkaṇḍeyas.): III, 183, †12588 (ºāndhakāḥ).--§ 555 (Sainyodyogap.): V, 19, 586 (Bhojāndha-Kºaiḥ, followed Kṛtavarman).--§ 556 (Sañjayayānap.): V, 29, 804 (followed Kṛshṇa).--§ 574 (Jambūkh.): VI, 9, 350.--§ 641 (Rājadh.): XII, 81, 3052.--§ 793 (Mausalap.): XVI, 3, 98 (ºāndhakāḥ, were exterminated). Cf. Kukkura, pl.
Kukshi^1, a Dānava. § 130 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 67, 2692 (Dānavānāṃ mahābalaḥ, incarnate as king Parvatīya).
Kukshi^2, § 717b (Nārāyaṇīya): XII, 349, V), 13589 (diśāṃ pālāya, son of Raibhya).
Kukurādhipa (“the king of the Kukuras”) = Ugrasena: XII, 8457.
